digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate T13, code-review surface-parity overlay
propositions: T13 plan-review overlay currently triggers only on prohibitions (blocking actions); approved scope widens the lexicon to also cover additive obligations (new contracts, invariants, schema fields, required arguments, sites that must stay in sync).

P1 analysis measured whether content-triggered surface-parity widening (CLI arg/guard changes requiring MCP and NDJSON/import updates) would cause unacceptable false positives: 10% genuine obligation, 70% not-owed, FP profile matches ~90%-none precedent; recommendation is to reject the broadening and prefer the deterministic write-parity contract oracle now in CI.

P0 import-integrity LLM criterion is declined in favor of deterministic full module import walk in CI (importlib rebar.* walk + scripts/ leg); P3 obligation-parity overlay is rejected as deterministically measurable; ci-gate-compat criterion is rejected per prior operator ruling (working-around gate failures institutionalizes incorrect behavior).

P2 code change approved as minimal-value prompt edit: adds obligation vocabulary to T13 rubric (plan_review_T13.md title/trigger paragraph), updates routing and guide, and extends deterministic pre-gate (det_gate_rules.py) with second alternation branch for additive-obligation phrasings; audit-verbatim branch unchanged; fires-side unit coverage added.

Gerrit change 2035 (P2 implementation) requires LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 gate votes; all targeted tests, lint, typecheck, and guide-parity validation pass; both APPROVED and DEFERRED work (P0 deterministic, P3 rejected) are recorded in ticket comments and operator rulings.
